feud.prompt: Name a book of the Bible that starts with the letter J
Name one of the Twelve Apostles
Name something Noah took with him on the ark
Name someone who visited the newborn Jesus
Name a fruit mentioned in the Bible

Name one of the Ten Plagues of Egypt

Name something the faithful do during Great Lent

clues.clue: Formed from the dust of the ground, he is the first man.
Commanded to build an ark, he and his house were saved through the flood.
Sold by his brothers for twenty pieces of silver, he rose to govern Egypt under Pharaoh.
At this place the LORD confused the language of all the earth and scattered men abroad.
Before God renamed him Abraham, the father of many nations bore this name.
The town of David where Jesus was born.
He baptized Jesus in the river Jordan and saw the Spirit descend like a dove.
Jesus turned water into wine at a wedding in this Galilean town — His first sign.
Though he swore he did not know the Lord, this disciple wept bitterly after the cock crew.

choices: What is the Mount of Olives?
clues.clue: By Orthodox tradition, the mountain of the Transfiguration, where Moses and Elijah appeared with Christ.
This psalm opens, 'The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.' (Psalm 22 in the Septuagint numbering.)
Proverbs teaches that the fear of the LORD is the beginning of this.
A shepherd boy who slew Goliath, he became king and is remembered as the sweet psalmist of Israel.

choices: What is the Song of Solomon?
clues.clue: 'Vanity of vanities; all is vanity,' sighs the Preacher in this book.

choices: What is a pillar of cloud?
clues.clue: After long silence, the LORD finally answered Job out of this.
Fifty days after Pascha, the Holy Spirit descended with tongues as of fire on this feast.
The first martyr, he saw the Son of man standing at the right hand of God as the stones flew.
'Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?' — the voice found Saul on the road to this city.
Paul's beloved companion, a physician who also wrote a Gospel and the Acts.
The apostles gathered in council in this city to settle the question of Gentile believers.
A righteous Israelite in Nineveh, blinded yet faithful — his son Tobias journeys with the angel Raphael.
She saved her city by cutting off the head of Holofernes, the Assyrian general.
Seven brothers and their mother chose death rather than eat swine's flesh, as told in this book.

clues.answer: What is the burning fiery furnace?
choices: What is the burning fiery furnace?
clues.clue: Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah sang praise to God from inside this, in the Prayer of Azariah.

clues.answer: What is the hand of God?
choices: What is the hand of God?
clues.clue: Completing the sentence from Wisdom: 'The souls of the righteous are in the hand of ____.'

jeopardyFinal.answer: What is the First Council of Nicaea?

meta.note: Authored for private play. Scripture references use KJV numbering; Orthodox (Septuagint) psalm numbers are noted where they differ. Family Feud boards are our own house rankings, not a real survey.

soundItOut.gibberish: Stan STILL, ann cun-SID-er thuh WUN-druss WURKS uv GAWD.
soundItOut.phrase: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

soundItOut.phrase: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

soundItOut.gibberish: Butt LET PAY-shunce HAV her PUR-fekt WURK,
soundItOut.phrase: But let patience have her perfect work,

soundItOut.gibberish: ann BEE yee KYnd WUN too uh-NUTH-er, TEN-der-HAR-ted,
soundItOut.phrase: and be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted,

soundItOut.gibberish: STUH-dee too SHOH thy-SELF uh-PROOVD UN-too GAWD,
soundItOut.phrase: Study to shew thyself approved unto God,

soundItOut.gibberish: uh FREND LUV-eth at AWL TYMZ, ann uh BRUTH-er iz BOHRN for ad-VER-sih-tee.
soundItOut.phrase: A friend loveth at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.

soundItOut.gibberish: in KWY-ut-ness un in KON-fih-dunce shal bee yawr STRENGKTH:
soundItOut.phrase: in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength:

soundItOut.gibberish: fore thuh JOY uv thuh LAWRD iz yor STRENGKTH.
soundItOut.phrase: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

soundItOut.gibberish: thuh PEESS uv GAWD, witch PASS-eth AWL un-der-STAN-ding,
soundItOut.phrase: the peace of God, which passeth all understanding,

soundItOut.gibberish: in thuh MUL-tih-tood uv KOWN-suh-lerz THAIR iz SAYF-tee.

soundItOut.gibberish: Thru WIZ-dum iz un HOWSS BIL-ded; un BY un-duh-STAN-ding IT iz es-TAB-lisht:

soundItOut.gibberish: wee WIL WAWK in thuh NAYM uv thuh LAWRD owr GAWD
soundItOut.phrase: we will walk in the name of the LORD our God

soundItOut.gibberish: uh STRAWNG HOHLD in thuh DAY uv TRUB-ul;
soundItOut.phrase: a strong hold in the day of trouble;

soundItOut.gibberish: Butt LET JUJ-ment RUN down az WAW-terz, ann RY-chus-ness az uh MY-tee STREEM.
soundItOut.phrase: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

soundItOut.gibberish: hee IZ GRAY-shus ann MER-sih-full, SLOH too ANG-ger,
soundItOut.phrase: he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger,

soundItOut.gibberish: thuh NAH-lij uv GAWD MAWR than BURNT AWF-er-ingz.
soundItOut.phrase: the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

soundItOut.gibberish: uh TYME too KEEP SY-lunce, ann uh TYME too SPEEK;
soundItOut.phrase: a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

soundItOut.gibberish: uh FAYTH-full FREND iz uh STRAWNG dee-FENSE:
soundItOut.phrase: A faithful friend is a strong defense:

soundItOut.gibberish: Seht uh WAHTCH, oh LAWRD, bih-FORE mah MOWTH;
soundItOut.phrase: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth;

soundItOut.gibberish: Soh TEECH us tuh NUM-buh owr DAYZ, dat wee MAY uh-PLY owr HARTS UN-too WIZ-dum.
soundItOut.phrase: So teach us to number our days, That we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

soundItOut.gibberish: WAIR-fore ree-SEEV yee WUN uh-NUTH-er, az KRYST AWL-soh ree-SEEVD US
soundItOut.phrase: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us

soundItOut.gibberish: wot-so-EV-uh TINGZ ahr TROO, wot-so-EV-uh TINGZ ahr ON-est, wot-so-EV-uh TINGZ ahr JUST,

soundItOut.gibberish: BET-er IZ uh DRY MOR-sul, ann KWY-ut-ness THAIR-with,

soundItOut.gibberish: Hee dat IZ SLOH tuh RATH iz uv GRAYT un-duh-STAN-ding:

soundItOut.gibberish: By hew-MIL-ih-tee ann thuh FEER uv thuh LAWRD ahr RICH-ez, ann ON-er, ann LYFE.

soundItOut.gibberish: cun-FESS yor FAWLTS WUN too uh-NUTH-er, ann PRAY WUN fore uh-NUTH-er,

soundItOut.gibberish: THIS BUUK uv thuh LAW shall NAWT dee-PART OWT uv thy MOWTH;

soundItOut.gibberish: ASK fore thuh OHLD PATHZ, WAIR iz thuh GUUD WAY, ann WAWK THAIR-in,

soundItOut.gibberish: Fore EZ-rah had pri-PAIRD hiz HART too SEEK thuh LAW uv thuh LAWRD,

soundItOut.gibberish: owr GAWD HOOM wee SURV iz AY-bull too dee-LIV-er US
soundItOut.phrase: our God whom we serve is able to deliver us

soundItOut.gibberish: fore THAIR iz NUN UTH-uh NAYM UN-duh HEV-en, GIV-un uh-MUNG MEN,

soundItOut.gibberish: KASS-ting AWL yor KAIR uh-PAWN him; fore hee KAIR-eth fore YOO.

soundItOut.gibberish: that WUN DAY iz with thuh LAWRD az uh THOW-zund YEERZ,

soundItOut.gibberish: My SUN, if THOW KUM too SURV thuh LAWRD, pri-PAIR thy SOHL fore temp-TAY-shun.

soundItOut.gibberish: thuh SOHLZ uv thuh RY-chus ahr in thuh HAND uv GAWD,

soundItOut.gibberish: hee WULL ree-JOISS OH-vuh THEE wiv JOI; hee WULL REST inn hiz LUVV

soundItOut.gibberish: KEEP thy HART with AWL DIL-ih-junce; Fore OWT uv IT ahr thuh ISH-yooz uv LYFE.
soundItOut.phrase: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.

soundItOut.gibberish: THOW wilt KEEP him in PUR-fekt PEESS, HOOZ mynd iz STAYD awn THEE:
soundItOut.phrase: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee:

soundItOut.gibberish: Leht yawr SPEEch bee AWL-wez wiv GRAISS, SEE-zund wiv SAWLT,

soundItOut.gibberish: yee KAN-nawt FYND thuh DEPTH uv thuh HART uv MAN, NY-ther kan yee per-SEEV thuh THINGZ that hee THINK-eth:

soundItOut.gibberish: wen THOW GIV-est AHMZ, let NAWT THINE eye bee EN-vee-us, NY-thuh TURN thy FAYSS frum EN-ee PAWR,

soundItOut.gibberish: hoo NOH-eth WETH-er THOW ahrt KUM too thuh KING-dum fore SUCH uh TYME az THIS?

soundItOut.gibberish: Buht dhuh WURD iz VER-ee NY UN-too THEE, inn thy MOWTH, un inn thy HART,

soundItOut.gibberish: hoo WIL NAWT SUF-fer YOO too bee TEMP-ted uh-BUV that yee ahr AY-bull;

soundItOut.gibberish: iv MAH PEE-pul, wich ahr KAWLD bah MAH NAYM, shal HUM-bul thum-SELVZ, un PRAY, un SEEK mah FAYSS,

soundItOut.gibberish: fore WHITH-er THOW GOH-est, Eye WIL GOH; ann WAIR THOW LOJ-est, Eye WIL LOJ:

soundItOut.gibberish: buht THY WERD, oh LAWRD, wich HEEL-uth AWL TINGZ.

soundItOut.gibberish: that thuh kuh-myoo-nih-KAY-shun uv THY FAYTH may bee-KUM ef-FEK-choo-al by thuh ak-NAH-lij-ing uv EV-ree GUUD THING

soundItOut.gibberish: Fore az IT wuz yor MYNDE too GOH uh-STRAY frum GAWD: soh, BEE-ing ree-TURND, SEEK him TEN TYMZ MAWR.

soundItOut.gibberish: fore dhuh TINGZ wich ahr SEEN ahr TEM-puh-ral; buht dhuh TINGZ wich ahr NAWT SEEN ahr ee-TURN-al.

soundItOut.gibberish: dat hee IZ uh ree-WAWR-duh uv dem dat DIL-ih-junt-lee SEEK him.

soundItOut.gibberish: NOW UN-too him dat IZ AY-bull tuh KEEP yoo frum FAWL-ing, un tuh pri-ZENT yoo FAWLT-less bih-FORE dhuh PREZ-ence uv hiz GLOR-ee
soundItOut.phrase: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory

soundItOut.gibberish: LUUK uh-PAWN thuh HEV-en ann thuh ERTH, ann AWL that IZ thair-IN, ann cun-SID-er that GAWD MAYD them uv THINGZ that wur NAWT;
soundItOut.phrase: look upon the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, and consider that God made them of things that were not;

soundItOut.gibberish: Thuh LAY-ber uv thuh AH-liv shall FAYL, ann thuh FEELDZ shall YEELD noh MEET;
soundItOut.phrase: The labour of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no meat;

soundItOut.gibberish: Ann LET him that IZ uh-THURST KUM. Ann hoo-so-EV-er WIL, let him TAYK thuh WAW-ter uv LYFE FREE-lee.
soundItOut.phrase: And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
